what: Generated by tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs from art/vehicles/*/vehicle.json: every roster vehicle, no hard-coded list.

vehicles.name: AU Hawk
vehicles.summary: Reference refinement: the AU Hawk keeps its broad teardrop headlamps, oval fish-mouth grille, tall glasshouse and rounded sedan body. The arch crowns now follow the original flank roll; the lower nose supports its bumper slot. Lamps lie on the actual body facets. Lean five-spoke silver wheels at close/medium distance and plain distant discs retain the faceted style. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2104 / 874 / 600 against 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. The reference sheets include a wing; the deliberate base-sedan no-wing interpretation is retained. Owner review decides recognisability.

vehicles.name: Cruz Missile
vehicles.summary: Narrower greenhouse through measured cabin stations and a tapered nose tip; 12-facet LOD0 tyres retain five-spoke depth. Front lamp wraps now clip onto the actual tub triangles, eliminating diagonal occlusion slits. At LOD1 the spoiler endplates retain both visible faces and their contour; hidden thickness funds the conforming lamps. Physics pivots are stored independently of visual extrema. Exported intact triangles: 1913 / 896 / 507 against 2800 / 900 / 600. Front-view cabin widths and nose taper improve; rear-view and small side-view silhouette regressions remain. The weighted score is essentially unchanged at LOD0 and improves slightly at LOD1/2. Lamp attachment is visually continuous after the projection repair; its side/fascia seam remains a visible faceted change in shading.

vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: Third likeness pass: wider lower stance, body widening starts lower, sloping shoulders above the wheels, narrower upper cabin, and a rounded nose in plan. Lamps sit closer to the reference shapes and heights; exhaust outlets are closer together. Cheap wheels retained; triangles 2702 / 879 / 597 within 2800 / 900 / 600. New reference-derived tests check local width, shoulder slope, nose taper, lamps/outlets and camera setup at every LOD. Collision hulls and handling retained.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: Reference refinement: the Lion President keeps its black roof, yellow fanged lamps, twin bonnet scoops, black/gold stripe and broad rear light bar. A flatter, wider fascia replaces the peaked bonnet tip; its corners recess into faceted planes. The upper arch flares roll back towards the shoulder, and the cabin tapers towards the roof. Flat five-spoke wheels replace hidden barrel and spoke-side geometry. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 1813 / 897 / 576 against 2400 / 900 / 600 budgets. The Hawk Dash spec twin remains unchanged.

Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Pig Catcher
vehicles.summary: Real annular tyres and open spoke interiors at every LOD replace opaque wheel caps. The rider has a tapered LOD0 torso, neck clearance, narrower leg stance, lower and better placed elbows, and a helmet peak even at the smallest tier. A retained beak transition avoids a single unbroken plank. Engine reduction was rejected after broad-form comparison; the enclosing engine volume is retained. Original collision inputs are frozen in colliders.json. Exported intact triangles: 2514 / 898 / 596 against 2800 / 900 / 600. Front/rear whole-view silhouettes improve at every tier. LOD0/1 weighted scores improve; LOD2 weighted score regresses by 0.0049, with side/top losses. The bike remains visibly approximate: plastics, engine and low-tier limbs are blockier than the sheet, and the rack/rope/sack differ in detail. It does not meet the general ~0.95 reference-parity target. Open spokes are a real geometry improvement that filled silhouette IoU cannot measure.

vehicles.name: Postie Bike
vehicles.summary: Rebuilt around classic CB50 architecture: a curved red/cream tank, exposed finned single-cylinder engine, open diamond frame, slim spoked wheels and one low right exhaust replace the scooter floor and leg shield. The postie rider, carrier, parcels and panniers retain the game identity. Exported triangles: 2287 / 877 / 593 within unchanged 2900 / 900 / 600 budgets. Physics hulls, wheel hubs, anchors and original hinges remain frozen. Owner review decides likeness.

vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: Owner-evidence rebuild: separate thin alloy flat tray, closed black TC-style canopy (no rear glazing or invented vents), horizontal amber/red/white tray lamps, checker guards and mudflaps, under-tray boxes and tow ball. The dual cab now follows the newer owner-model rake and narrower tapered roof; roof rack, left awning and right snorkel remain recognizable. Tray/canopy dimensions use the owner tape measurements of 2026-10-21. Existing wheel pivots, collider hull, anchors and handling are frozen. Cab/front styling remains a faceted interpretation, not a scan. LOD0/1/2 qualified budgets remain 2400/900/600; measured totals are recorded in validation.md.
